description: Movie-poster-style meme titled 'FISAGATE' against a fiery orange sky. It composites portraits of Barack Obama (center top), Hillary Clinton, James Comey, Loretta Lynch, and Andrew McCabe, casting them as figures in the FISA surveillance controversy. Below the title, five-star 'review' quotes about the FISA memo are attributed to Republican congressmen Mark Meadows, Jim Jordan, Matt Gaetz, Steve King, and Scott Perry.
text: FISAGATE. "What I saw is absolutely shocking." Mark Meadows. "It is so alarming the American people have to see this" Jim Jordan. "There has been a real attempt to undermine this President & it comes from the scariest of places." Matt Gaetz. "The sickening reality has set in. I no longer hold out hope there is an innocent explanation for the information the public has seen." Steve King. "As soon as you read the Memo, you think, is this happening in America or is this the KGB?" Scott Perry.
flags: Meme frames the FISA controversy as a scandal implicating the pictured officials; the quotes are partisan commentary presented as film-review blurbs, not verified findings.
